title: Songbirds Singing Group (Over 50s)
intro: This is a LinkAge Plus activity for people aged 50+.

image.alt: Singing class in the Toynbee Hall Community Centre

sections.text: Join this friendly group who come together to socialise and sing a range of songs, modern and old in a range of styles. No singing skills required, it is all about enjoying yourself in a group setting and joining in!
Fridays (fortnightly, alternate Fridays) 10.30am-12.30pm Community Centre, 28 Commercial Street, London, E1 6LS
Please contact the centre ahead of joining to check which week the session is running:
